subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: The Cost of a Breach
description: One-minute skill: The Cost of a Breach.

hook.text: A company's database is stolen. 40 million credit cards exposed. The average breach costs $4.5 million.

buildup.text: Breaches cost money through fines, lawsuits, remediation, lost customers, and damaged reputation.

discovery.text: IBM's annual report shows the average time to detect a breach is 204 days. Damage compounds daily.

twist.text: Most breaches exploit known vulnerabilities that already had patches available at the time of attack.

climax.text: Companies that test security regularly reduce breach costs by 65% through earlier detection.

punchline.text: Breaches are expensive. Testing is cheap by comparison.

quiz.question: What is the average cost of a data breach according to IBM?
